parts.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - the term - \sigmaFn\tilde{n} of the continuous model: -2 rays a firing, at rate \sigma, on the share F of the matches, of degree 2 in the density; what this fact takes from it is below. ANNIHILATION fires at \sigma·F·\rho^{2}, and ONE firing of it puts -1 into the space ledger - counted off the body, not written down. steps.because: the rules, read as a line: every rule of the theory is a term, the reading having run each rule's program on a symbolic match and counted what it does to the population - what it makes, what it takes, what it carries, what a body puts in - so the line is what the rules come to as a crowd rather than a description of them. Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

steps.via: what motion does to what a body sends
working: EMISSION is gated on not(moving), so it shines on 1 - \beta of its ticks
that is the same every way, so it is in \bar{m} and not here
one cell a tick, so \bar{r} cells is \bar{r} ticks
two rays a tick apart land 1 - \beta\cdot\hat{d} ticks apart
steps.because: ONE MOTION, TWO EFFECTS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS HERE. `EMISSION` is gated on `spare = not(moving)`, so a tick spent crossing a cell is a tick not spent shining and a body emits on 1 - \beta of its ticks - THE SAME IN EVERY DIRECTION, so that is how much the body sends and it is already in the mass, inside the source's own choice, `l.choose\paren{\bar{m}_{x} l.DEG \paren{1 - \beta}}`. WHAT IS DIRECTIONAL IS THE OTHER HALF: `MOVEMENT` gives one cell a tick, so a distance IS a time, and between two emissions a tick apart the body has closed \beta\cdot\hat{d} of the way to wherever the ray is going - they land that much closer together and what arrives per tick is the reciprocal. IT IS THE CLASSICAL DOPPLER FACTOR and nothing about waves or observers went into it. A body blocks the vacuum's making whether it moves or not, so this is on the meeting term and nowhere else
